newsitem.title: USA: CSX says tender for Conrail oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: CSX says tender for Conrail oversubscribed.

text.p: CSX Corp said Thursday that its $110 cash tender offer for shares of Conrail Inc was oversubscribed, with about 76,629,202 shares tendered based on a preliminary count.
CSX proceeded with its offer after a federal appeals court on Wednesday denied Norfolk Southern Corp's effort to block it.
The company said about 50,497,768 of the Conrail shares were tendered by notice of guaranteed delivery.

CSX said its subsidiary making the offer, Green Acquisition Corp, accepted for payment 17,860,124 Conrail shares, representing about 19.9 percent of Conrail's outstanding voting shares. It said the preliminary proration factor for the offer is 23 percent and final proration is expected to be announced around November 27, with payment for shares accepted to start "promptly thereafter."
CSX is seeking to buy 40 percent of Pennsylvania-based Conrail's shares for cash. It is unable to buy more than 20 percent without shareholder approval under Pennsylvania law.
CSX's offer for 19.9 percent of Conrail's shares is the first step in an $8.5 billion cash and stock merger between the companies.

Norfolk Southern is pursuing a hostile $10 billion cash offer for Conrail and has until 1400 EDT/1900 GMT Thursday to present arguments to a U.S. Court of Appeals panel supporting its request to block the merger.
